title: Competitor Psychographics & Model Landscape Dossier — Prospect Prioritization
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a single actionable dossier that blends competitor psychographic profiles (buyer motivations, messaging resonance, pricing pain points) with a prioritized model-landscape map for Redwood field and GTM teams. Deliverables: 1) psychographic personas for 6 primary competitor buyer cohorts, 2) a heatmapped model-compatibility and risk matrix across latency/cost/availability dimensions, 3) a prioritized prospect list with recommended engagement play for each (self-serve, sales-assisted, enterprise). This ticket coordinates PM research, 3 interviews with sales leads, and a lightweight signals ingest from telemetry and public announcements.
acceptance_criteria: Dossier PDF uploaded to Drive with executive summary and 5x one-pagers for buyer cohorts
Heatmap CSV with model compatibility scores and short rationale for each score
Prioritized prospect list (top 50 accounts) with recommended play and one-sentence risk summary
Short recording (<= 20 min) capturing top 3 tactical recommendations for Sales and Product Strategy
research_plan: 1) Synthesize public signal corpus (announcements, pricing pages, blog posts) for 12 competitors. 2) Instrument recent usage telemetry (top request patterns, latency buckets) to translate into model-compatibility heuristics. 3) 3x structured interviews: 2 sales reps (enterprise & midmarket), 1 solutions engineer. 4) Quick survey to 40 trial users for messaging resonance. 5) Consolidate into dossier and run a 30-min sync with GTM and Product Ops.
data_sources: public: pricing pages, blog posts, docs archives
stakeholders: Elena Cruz — Head of Field Marketing
Research Ops — support for surveys and data pulls
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: survey sample biased toward PLG users — Mitigation: weight signals by account ARR and directly interview 5 paid customers
Risk: telemetry noisy for less-common models — Mitigation: flag low-confidence scores and surface as qualitative notes
Risk: competitor messaging shifts mid-sprint — Mitigation: include a 1-week cadence for 'rapid refresh' of signal corpus before finalization
tradeoffs_discussed: Depth vs. breadth: focus on 6 competitors and 4 buyer cohorts instead of exhaustive coverage to remain actionable within sprint
Quantitative scoring vs. qualitative narrative: produce a hybrid heatmap with explicit confidence bands and supporting vignettes
